title: GeneTrek
description: GeneTrek brings together curated gene lists for neurodevelopmental disorders and per-gene annotations (constraint, expression, rare-variant results) in one versioned table, to search, compare against an explicit background, and download. Web application: https://genetrek.pasteur.fr. The code is under the MIT licence; the data keep each source's terms, listed per column in DATA_LICENCES.md.

creators.name: Human Genetics and Cognitive Functions, Institut Pasteur
